request.style: English, female solo voice with gospel choir, piano, strings, drums, cymbals, hopeful and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name
Bring an offering and enter his courts
Worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness
Tremble before him all the earth

[Chorus]
The Lord reigns the world stands firm
It cannot be shaken by fear
He will judge the peoples with fairness
The Lord is here he is near

[Verse]
Say among the nations that the Lord reigns
The world stands firm and cannot be shaken
He will judge the peoples with fairness
His word is true his promise remains

[Chorus]
The Lord reigns the world stands firm
It cannot be shaken by fear
He will judge the peoples with fairness
The Lord is here he is near

[Bridge]
Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be glad
Let the sea and all that fills it resound
Let the field exult and everything in it
All the trees of the forest will sing for joy

[Chorus]
The Lord reigns the world stands firm
It cannot be shaken by fear
He will judge the peoples with fairness
The Lord is here he is near

[Outro]
He is coming to judge the earth
He will judge the world in righteousness
